# Integrating an EMR with CODA

This guide adds **Search with CODA** to an EMR, lab, pharmacy or any other clinical web system:

1. The clinician highlights a phrase, right-clicks and chooses **Search with CODA**.
2. Your server launches CODA for that clinician. They are already signed in, for that one session.
3. They pick codes.
4. The codes come back into the field, and to your server as a signed webhook.

The same recipes are in CODA's **Developer hub ▸ Recipes**, filled in with your CODA address and app.

## Before you start

You need these from a CODA administrator, all in the Developer hub:

- **Connected apps:** an **app id**, with your EMR's web origins registered.
- **API keys:** an **integration key** for your server. It is shown once; keep it server-side only.
- **Webhooks:** a **webhook endpoint** and its signing secret, also shown once.

### Patient context (HIPAA)

CODA never needs to know who the patient is, so it receives only the minimum necessary:

- **Phrase:** send only the clinical phrase. CODA strips identifiers copied along by mistake, but that is a safety net.
- **References:** `patientRef`, `encounterRef` and `clinician.ref` are random tokens that your system generates and maps itself. They must not be derived from identifiers: no MRN, no hash of an MRN, no name or date (45 CFR 164.514(c)). CODA rejects values that look like identifiers.
- **Webhooks:** they carry your tokens back, never free text.
- **Agreement:** put a Business Associate Agreement in place wherever PHI could reach CODA.


## Configuration (every server)

Server-side only. The integration key comes from Developer hub ▸ API keys, the webhook secret from Developer hub ▸ Webhooks (both shown once).

```bash
CODA_URL=https://coda.hospital.ng
CODA_APP_ID=<your app id>
CODA_API_KEY=coda_sk_...            # never in a web page or a repository
CODA_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_...
EMR_ORIGIN=https://emr.hospital.ng           # where your EMR's pages are served (registered on the app)
```

## Node.js (TypeScript, Express)

An Express server: pseudonymous references, the launch endpoint your page calls, and the webhook receiver.

### Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ubeffiong/coda-sdks/main/install.sh | sh -s -- typescript
npm install express
```

### `src/codaRefs.ts`

Opaque references: one random token per patient, encounter and user, kept in your database. Never send an MRN, a hash of one, a name or a date to CODA.

```ts
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { db } from './db'; // your database

type Kind = 'patient' | 'encounter' | 'user';
const PREFIX: Record<Kind, string> = { patient: 'pt', encounter: 'enc', user: 'usr' };

/** The token CODA sees for one of your records; created once, then reused. */
export async function codaRef(kind: Kind, localId: string): Promise<string> {
  const existing = await db.codaRefs.find({ kind, localId });
  if (existing) return existing.token;
  const token = `${PREFIX[kind]}_${randomUUID()}`;
  await db.codaRefs.insert({ kind, localId, token });
  return token;
}

/** Back from a webhook: which of your records a token stands for. */
export async function localIdFor(kind: Kind, token: string): Promise<string | null> {
  return (await db.codaRefs.find({ kind, token }))?.localId ?? null;
}
```

### `src/server.ts`

The launch endpoint opens a session with your integration key on behalf of the signed-in clinician; the webhook endpoint verifies and saves the result.

```ts
import express from 'express';
import { CodaClient, verifyWebhook } from '@coda-terminology/client';
import { codaRef, localIdFor } from './codaRefs';
import { requireLogin } from './auth'; // your own session middleware (req.user)
import { db } from './db';

const coda = new CodaClient({ baseUrl: process.env.CODA_URL!, token: process.env.CODA_API_KEY! });
const app = express();

// 1. Called by the EMR page: open CODA for the signed-in clinician (no CODA sign-in).
app.post('/coda/launch', requireLogin, express.json(), async (req, res) => {
  const { chartId, encounterId, text, maxSelections } = req.body as { chartId: string; encounterId: string; text: string; maxSelections?: number };
  const session = await coda.openConnectSession({
    appId: process.env.CODA_APP_ID!,
    text,                                   // the clinical phrase only
    maxSelections,
    returnOrigin: process.env.EMR_ORIGIN,   // results come back to this page
    patientRef: await codaRef('patient', chartId),
    encounterRef: await codaRef('encounter', encounterId),
    clinician: { ref: await codaRef('user', req.user.id), name: req.user.displayName },
  });
  res.json({ launchUrl: session.launchUrl });
});

// 2. Durable delivery: CODA signs every webhook; verify the raw body.
app.post('/coda/webhooks', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }), async (req, res) => {
  const body = req.body.toString('utf8');
  if (!(await verifyWebhook(process.env.CODA_WEBHOOK_SECRET!, req.headers, body))) return res.sendStatus(401);

  const eventId = String(req.headers['webhook-id']);
  if (await db.processedWebhooks.has(eventId)) return res.sendStatus(204); // delivered at least once
  const event = JSON.parse(body) as { type: string; data: any };

  if (event.type === 'connect.selection.completed') {
    const encounterId = await localIdFor('encounter', event.data.encounterRef);
    if (encounterId) {
      for (const s of event.data.selections) {
        await db.diagnoses.upsert({ encounterId, system: s.system, version: s.version, code: s.code, display: s.display });
      }
    }
  }
  await db.processedWebhooks.add(eventId);
  res.sendStatus(204);
});

// 3. Optional: pull a result instead of (or as well as) the webhook.
app.get('/coda/sessions/:id', requireLogin, async (req, res) => res.json(await coda.getConnectSession(req.params.id)));

app.listen(3000);
```

Your EMR page: use the [plain JavaScript page](#plain-javascript-page) or the [React](#react-with-css) recipe.

## Python (FastAPI)

A FastAPI service with the same three endpoints.

### Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ubeffiong/coda-sdks/main/install.sh | sh -s -- python
pip install fastapi uvicorn
```

### `coda_refs.py`

Opaque references, one random token per record, stored in your database.

```python
import uuid
from db import db  # your database

PREFIX = {"patient": "pt", "encounter": "enc", "user": "usr"}


def coda_ref(kind: str, local_id: str) -> str:
    """The token CODA sees for one of your records; created once, then reused."""
    row = db.coda_refs.find_one(kind=kind, local_id=local_id)
    if row:
        return row["token"]
    token = f"{PREFIX[kind]}_{uuid.uuid4()}"
    db.coda_refs.insert(kind=kind, local_id=local_id, token=token)
    return token


def local_id_for(kind: str, token: str):
    row = db.coda_refs.find_one(kind=kind, token=token)
    return row["local_id"] if row else None
```

### `main.py`

Launch endpoint, webhook receiver and an optional pull.

```python
import json
import os

from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel
from coda_client import CodaClient, verify_webhook

from auth import current_user  # your own session dependency
from coda_refs import coda_ref, local_id_for
from db import db

coda = CodaClient(os.environ["CODA_URL"], os.environ["CODA_API_KEY"])
app = FastAPI()


class Launch(BaseModel):
    chartId: str
    encounterId: str
    text: str
    maxSelections: int | None = None


@app.post("/coda/launch")
def launch(body: Launch, user=Depends(current_user)):
    """Called by the EMR page: open CODA for the signed-in clinician (no CODA sign-in)."""
    session = coda.open_connect_session(
        os.environ["CODA_APP_ID"],
        body.text,  # the clinical phrase only
        max_selections=body.maxSelections,
        return_origin=os.environ["EMR_ORIGIN"],
        patient_ref=coda_ref("patient", body.chartId),
        encounter_ref=coda_ref("encounter", body.encounterId),
        clinician_ref=coda_ref("user", user.id),
        clinician_name=user.display_name,
    )
    return {"launchUrl": session["launchUrl"]}


@app.post("/coda/webhooks")
async def webhooks(request: Request):
    body = (await request.body()).decode("utf-8")  # the raw body, exactly as received
    if not verify_webhook(os.environ["CODA_WEBHOOK_SECRET"], dict(request.headers), body):
        return Response(status_code=401)
    event_id = request.headers["webhook-id"]
    if db.processed_webhooks.has(event_id):
        return Response(status_code=204)
    event = json.loads(body)
    if event["type"] == "connect.selection.completed":
        encounter_id = local_id_for("encounter", event["data"]["encounterRef"])
        if encounter_id:
            for s in event["data"]["selections"]:
                db.diagnoses.upsert(encounter_id=encounter_id, system=s["system"], version=s["version"], code=s["code"], display=s["display"])
    db.processed_webhooks.add(event_id)
    return Response(status_code=204)


@app.get("/coda/sessions/{session_id}")
def pull(session_id: str, user=Depends(current_user)):
    return coda.get_connect_session(session_id)
```

Your EMR page: use the [plain JavaScript page](#plain-javascript-page) or the [React](#react-with-css) recipe.

## C# (ASP.NET Core)

An ASP.NET Core minimal API with the same three endpoints.

### Install

```bash
dotnet new web -o EmrCoda && cd EmrCoda
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ubeffiong/coda-sdks/main/install.ps1))) dotnet
```

### `CodaRefs.cs`

Opaque references, one random token per record, stored in your database.

```csharp
public sealed class CodaRefs(AppDb db)
{
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> Prefix = new() { ["patient"] = "pt", ["encounter"] = "enc", ["user"] = "usr" };

    /// <summary>The token CODA sees for one of your records; created once, then reused.</summary>
    public async Task<string> RefAsync(string kind, string localId)
    {
        var row = await db.CodaRefs.FindAsync(kind, localId);
        if (row is not null) return row.Token;
        var token = $"{Prefix[kind]}_{Guid.NewGuid()}";
        db.CodaRefs.Add(new CodaRef(kind, localId, token));
        await db.SaveChangesAsync();
        return token;
    }

    public async Task<string?> LocalIdAsync(string kind, string token) =>
        (await db.CodaRefs.SingleOrDefaultAsync(r => r.Kind == kind && r.Token == token))?.LocalId;
}
```

### `Program.cs`

Launch endpoint, webhook receiver and an optional pull.

```csharp
using System.Text.Json;
using Coda.Client;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
var config = builder.Configuration;
builder.Services.AddSingleton(_ => new CodaClient(new CodaClientOptions
{
    BaseUrl = new Uri(config["CODA_URL"]!),
    TokenProvider = CodaClientOptions.StaticToken(config["CODA_API_KEY"]!),
}));
builder.Services.AddScoped<CodaRefs>();
var app = builder.Build();

// 1. Called by the EMR page: open CODA for the signed-in clinician (no CODA sign-in).
app.MapPost("/coda/launch", async (LaunchRequest body, HttpContext http, CodaClient coda, CodaRefs refs) =>
{
    var user = http.User; // your own authentication
    var session = await coda.OpenConnectSessionAsync(new ConnectSessionRequest
    {
        AppId = config["CODA_APP_ID"]!,
        Text = body.Text,                       // the clinical phrase only
        MaxSelections = body.MaxSelections,
        ReturnOrigin = config["EMR_ORIGIN"],
        PatientRef = await refs.RefAsync("patient", body.ChartId),
        EncounterRef = await refs.RefAsync("encounter", body.EncounterId),
        Clinician = new ConnectClinician(await refs.RefAsync("user", user.FindFirst("sub")!.Value), user.Identity?.Name),
    });
    return Results.Ok(new { launchUrl = session["launchUrl"]!.GetValue<string>() });
}).RequireAuthorization();

// 2. Durable delivery: verify the raw body, de-duplicate on webhook-id.
app.MapPost("/coda/webhooks", async (HttpRequest request, CodaRefs refs, AppDb db) =>
{
    using var reader = new StreamReader(request.Body);
    var body = await reader.ReadToEndAsync();
    var headers = request.Headers.Select(h => KeyValuePair.Create(h.Key, h.Value.ToString()));
    if (!CodaWebhooks.Verify(config["CODA_WEBHOOK_SECRET"]!, headers, body)) return Results.Unauthorized();

    var eventId = request.Headers["webhook-id"].ToString();
    if (await db.ProcessedWebhooks.FindAsync(eventId) is not null) return Results.NoContent();
    using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(body);
    var e = doc.RootElement;
    if (e.GetProperty("type").GetString() == "connect.selection.completed")
    {
        var data = e.GetProperty("data");
        var encounterId = await refs.LocalIdAsync("encounter", data.GetProperty("encounterRef").GetString()!);
        if (encounterId is not null)
        {
            foreach (var s in data.GetProperty("selections").EnumerateArray())
                db.Diagnoses.Add(new Diagnosis(encounterId, s.GetProperty("system").GetString()!, s.GetProperty("version").GetString()!,
                    s.GetProperty("code").GetString()!, s.GetProperty("display").GetString()!));
        }
    }
    db.ProcessedWebhooks.Add(new ProcessedWebhook(eventId));
    await db.SaveChangesAsync();
    return Results.NoContent();
});

// 3. Optional: pull a result.
app.MapGet("/coda/sessions/{id}", async (string id, CodaClient coda) => Results.Ok(await coda.GetConnectSessionAsync(id))).RequireAuthorization();

app.Run();

public sealed record LaunchRequest(string ChartId, string EncounterId, string Text, int? MaxSelections);
```

Your EMR page: use the [plain JavaScript page](#plain-javascript-page) or the [React](#react-with-css) recipe.

## Java (Spring Boot)

A Spring Boot controller with the same three endpoints.

### Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ubeffiong/coda-sdks/main/install.sh | sh -s -- java
```

### `src/main/java/com/hospital/coda/CodaController.java`

Launch endpoint, webhook receiver and an optional pull. CodaRefs is your repository of opaque tokens (random UUID per record).

```java
package com.hospital.coda;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.security.Principal;
import java.util.Map;
import org.coda.client.CodaClient;
import org.coda.client.CodaWebhooks;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/coda")
class CodaController {
    private final CodaClient coda = CodaClient.builder()
            .baseUrl(System.getenv("CODA_URL"))
            .token(System.getenv("CODA_API_KEY"))
            .build();
    private final ObjectMapper json = new ObjectMapper();
    private final CodaRefs refs;            // your repository of opaque tokens
    private final DiagnosisStore diagnoses; // your own persistence

    CodaController(CodaRefs refs, DiagnosisStore diagnoses) {
        this.refs = refs;
        this.diagnoses = diagnoses;
    }

    record Launch(String chartId, String encounterId, String text, Integer maxSelections) {}

    /** 1. Called by the EMR page: open CODA for the signed-in clinician (no CODA sign-in). */
    @PostMapping("/launch")
    Map<String, String> launch(@RequestBody Launch body, Principal user) {
        var request = CodaClient.ConnectSessionRequest.of(System.getenv("CODA_APP_ID"), body.text())
                .withReturnOrigin(System.getenv("EMR_ORIGIN"))
                .withPatientRef(refs.ref("patient", body.chartId()))
                .withEncounterRef(refs.ref("encounter", body.encounterId()))
                .withClinician(refs.ref("user", user.getName()), null);
        if (body.maxSelections() != null) request = request.withMaxSelections(body.maxSelections());
        return Map.of("launchUrl", coda.openConnectSession(request).get("launchUrl").asText());
    }

    /** 2. Durable delivery: verify the raw body, de-duplicate on webhook-id. */
    @PostMapping(value = "/webhooks", consumes = "application/json")
    ResponseEntity<Void> webhooks(@RequestHeader Map<String, String> headers, @RequestBody String body) throws Exception {
        if (!CodaWebhooks.verify(System.getenv("CODA_WEBHOOK_SECRET"), headers, body)) return ResponseEntity.status(401).build();
        String eventId = headers.get("webhook-id");
        if (diagnoses.alreadyProcessed(eventId)) return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
        JsonNode event = json.readTree(body);
        if ("connect.selection.completed".equals(event.get("type").asText())) {
            String encounterId = refs.localId("encounter", event.get("data").get("encounterRef").asText());
            if (encounterId != null) {
                for (JsonNode s : event.get("data").get("selections")) {
                    diagnoses.save(encounterId, s.get("system").asText(), s.get("version").asText(), s.get("code").asText(), s.get("display").asText());
                }
            }
        }
        diagnoses.markProcessed(eventId);
        return ResponseEntity.noContent().build();
    }

    /** 3. Optional: pull a result. */
    @GetMapping("/sessions/{id}")
    JsonNode pull(@PathVariable String id) {
        return coda.getConnectSession(id);
    }
}
```

Your EMR page: use the [plain JavaScript page](#plain-javascript-page) or the [React](#react-with-css) recipe.

## Go (net/http)

A net/http server with the same three endpoints.

### Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ubeffiong/coda-sdks/main/install.sh | sh -s -- go
```

### `main.go`

Launch endpoint, webhook receiver and an optional pull. refs and store are your own (random token per record; your diagnoses).

```go
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"time"

	coda "github.com/ubeffiong/coda-sdks/go"
)

func main() {
	client, err := coda.New(coda.Options{BaseURL: os.Getenv("CODA_URL"), Token: coda.StaticToken(os.Getenv("CODA_API_KEY"))})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}

	// 1. Called by the EMR page: open CODA for the signed-in clinician (no CODA sign-in).
	http.HandleFunc("POST /coda/launch", requireLogin(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, user User) {
		var body struct {
			ChartID, EncounterID, Text string
			MaxSelections              int
		}
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "bad request", http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		session, err := client.OpenConnectSession(r.Context(), coda.ConnectSessionRequest{
			AppID:         os.Getenv("CODA_APP_ID"),
			Text:          body.Text, // the clinical phrase only
			MaxSelections: body.MaxSelections,
			ReturnOrigin:  os.Getenv("EMR_ORIGIN"),
			PatientRef:    refs.Ref("patient", body.ChartID),
			EncounterRef:  refs.Ref("encounter", body.EncounterID),
			Clinician:     &coda.Clinician{Ref: refs.Ref("user", user.ID), Name: user.DisplayName},
		})
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "could not open CODA", http.StatusBadGateway)
			return
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"launchUrl": session["launchUrl"]})
	}))

	// 2. Durable delivery: verify the raw body, de-duplicate on webhook-id.
	http.HandleFunc("POST /coda/webhooks", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		if !coda.VerifyWebhook(os.Getenv("CODA_WEBHOOK_SECRET"), r.Header, body, time.Now(), 5*time.Minute) {
			http.Error(w, "bad signature", http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}
		eventID := r.Header.Get("webhook-id")
		if store.Processed(eventID) {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			return
		}
		var event struct {
			Type string
			Data struct {
				EncounterRef string
				Selections   []struct{ System, Version, Code, Display string }
			}
		}
		_ = json.Unmarshal(body, &event)
		if event.Type == "connect.selection.completed" {
			if encounterID, ok := refs.LocalID("encounter", event.Data.EncounterRef); ok {
				for _, s := range event.Data.Selections {
					store.SaveDiagnosis(encounterID, s.System, s.Version, s.Code, s.Display)
				}
			}
		}
		store.MarkProcessed(eventID)
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
	})

	// 3. Optional: pull a result.
	http.HandleFunc("GET /coda/sessions/{id}", requireLogin(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, _ User) {
		s, err := client.GetConnectSession(r.Context(), r.PathValue("id"))
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadGateway)
			return
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(s)
	}))

	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":3000", nil))
}
```

## Rust (axum)

An axum server with the same three endpoints. The SDK is blocking, so calls run on spawn_blocking.

### Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ubeffiong/coda-sdks/main/install.sh | sh -s -- rust
cargo add axum tokio --features tokio/full
cargo add serde --features derive
cargo add serde_json
```

### `src/main.rs`

Launch endpoint, webhook receiver and an optional pull. refs and store are your own.

```rust
use axum::{extract::{Path, State}, http::{HeaderMap, StatusCode}, routing::{get, post}, Json, Router};
use coda_client::{Client, Clinician, ConnectSessionRequest};
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

#[derive(Clone)]
struct App { coda: Client }

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
struct Launch { chart_id: String, encounter_id: String, text: String, max_selections: Option<u32> }

/// 1. Called by the EMR page: open CODA for the signed-in clinician (no CODA sign-in).
async fn launch(State(app): State<App>, user: User, Json(body): Json<Launch>) -> Result<Json<Value>, StatusCode> {
    let request = ConnectSessionRequest {
        app_id: std::env::var("CODA_APP_ID").unwrap(),
        text: Some(body.text), // the clinical phrase only
        max_selections: body.max_selections,
        return_origin: std::env::var("EMR_ORIGIN").ok(),
        patient_ref: Some(refs::get("patient", &body.chart_id)),
        encounter_ref: Some(refs::get("encounter", &body.encounter_id)),
        clinician: Some(Clinician { reference: refs::get("user", &user.id), name: Some(user.display_name) }),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let session = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || app.coda.open_connect_session(&request))
        .await.map_err(|_| StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)?
        .map_err(|_| StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY)?;
    Ok(Json(json!({ "launchUrl": session["launchUrl"] })))
}

/// 2. Durable delivery: verify the raw body, de-duplicate on webhook-id.
async fn webhooks(headers: HeaderMap, body: String) -> StatusCode {
    let h = |k: &str| headers.get(k).and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok()).unwrap_or_default().to_string();
    let now = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_secs() as i64;
    let secret = std::env::var("CODA_WEBHOOK_SECRET").unwrap();
    if !coda_client::verify_webhook(&secret, &h("webhook-id"), &h("webhook-timestamp"), &h("webhook-signature"), &body, now, 300) {
        return StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED;
    }
    if store::processed(&h("webhook-id")) { return StatusCode::NO_CONTENT; }
    let event: Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap_or_default();
    if event["type"] == "connect.selection.completed" {
        if let Some(encounter_id) = refs::local_id("encounter", event["data"]["encounterRef"].as_str().unwrap_or_default()) {
            for s in event["data"]["selections"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
                store::save_diagnosis(&encounter_id, s);
            }
        }
    }
    store::mark_processed(&h("webhook-id"));
    StatusCode::NO_CONTENT
}

/// 3. Optional: pull a result.
async fn pull(State(app): State<App>, Path(id): Path<String>) -> Result<Json<Value>, StatusCode> {
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || app.coda.get_connect_session(&id))
        .await.map_err(|_| StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)?
        .map(Json).map_err(|_| StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY)
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let coda = Client::new(&std::env::var("CODA_URL").unwrap(), &std::env::var("CODA_API_KEY").unwrap());
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/coda/launch", post(launch))
        .route("/coda/webhooks", post(webhooks))
        .route("/coda/sessions/{id}", get(pull))
        .with_state(App { coda });
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("0.0.0.0:3000").await.unwrap();
    axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}
```

Your EMR page: use the [plain JavaScript page](#plain-javascript-page) or the [React](#react-with-css) recipe.

## Plain JavaScript page

Any web page: right-click "Search with CODA", launched through your server. Pair it with one of the server recipes.

### Install

```bash
# Nothing to install: CODA serves the module at https://coda.hospital.ng/connect.js
```

### `emr-page.html`

In your EMR page. The clinician highlights text, right-clicks ▸ Search with CODA; the script asks your server to launch them (no CODA sign-in) and inserts the chosen code into the field.

```html
<textarea id="note">Known type 2 diabetes. Diabetic nephropathy noted last year.</textarea>
<input id="diagnosis" placeholder="Right-click selected text to code it">

<script type="module">
  import { CodaConnect } from 'https://coda.hospital.ng/connect.js';

  // Your page already knows which chart is open; send your own ids, your server maps them.
  const chart = { chartId: window.EMR.chartId, encounterId: window.EMR.encounterId };

  const coda = new CodaConnect({
    codaUrl: 'https://coda.hospital.ng',
    appId: '<your app id>',
    display: 'modal', // in-page dialog; 'popup' opens a window
    defaults: { purpose: 'diagnosis', maxSelections: 3 },
    // Your server opens the session with its key and returns the launch URL.
    launch: async (pick) => {
      const r = await fetch('/coda/launch', {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ...chart, text: pick.text, maxSelections: pick.maxSelections }),
      });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Could not open CODA');
      return r.json(); // { launchUrl }
    },
  });

  coda.attachContextMenu(document.body, {
    onSelect: (result, field) => coda.insertInto(field, result.selections[0], 'display-code'),
    onError: (e) => console.error('CODA:', e),
  });
</script>
```

## React (with CSS)

A hook, a coded field component and its CSS. Pair it with one of the server recipes.

### Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ubeffiong/coda-sdks/main/install.sh | sh -s -- typescript
# .env: VITE_CODA_URL=https://coda.hospital.ng  VITE_CODA_APP_ID=<your app id>
```

### `src/coda/useCodaConnect.ts`

A hook around the drop-in module from the SDK. The launch goes through your server, so the clinician never signs in to CODA.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { CodaConnect, CodaConnectCancelled, type ConnectResult, type PickOptions } from '@coda-terminology/client/connect';

const CODA_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_CODA_URL;      // https://coda.hospital.ng
const APP_ID = import.meta.env.VITE_CODA_APP_ID;     // <your app id>

export interface ChartContext { chartId: string; encounterId: string }

export function useCodaConnect(chart: ChartContext) {
  const coda = useMemo(() => new CodaConnect({
    codaUrl: CODA_URL,
    appId: APP_ID,
    display: 'modal',
    defaults: { purpose: 'diagnosis', maxSelections: 3 },
    launch: async (pick) => {
      const r = await fetch('/coda/launch', {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ...chart, text: pick.text, maxSelections: pick.maxSelections }),
      });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Could not open CODA');
      return (await r.json()) as { launchUrl: string };
    },
  }), [chart.chartId, chart.encounterId]);

  /** Opens CODA for the text; resolves with the selection, or null when the clinician cancels. */
  async function pick(options: PickOptions): Promise<ConnectResult | null> {
    try {
      return await coda.pick(options);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof CodaConnectCancelled) return null;
      throw e;
    }
  }

  /** Right-click "Search with CODA" inside the element this ref is attached to. */
  function useContextMenu<T extends HTMLElement>(onSelect: (r: ConnectResult) => void) {
    const ref = useRef<T>(null);
    useEffect(() => {
      if (!ref.current) return;
      return coda.attachContextMenu(ref.current, { onSelect: (r) => onSelect(r) });
    }, [onSelect]);
    return ref;
  }

  return { pick, useContextMenu };
}
```

### `src/coda/CodedField.tsx`

A diagnosis field with a "Code with CODA" button and the chosen codes as chips.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { ConnectSelection } from '@coda-terminology/client/connect';
import { useCodaConnect, type ChartContext } from './useCodaConnect';
import './CodedField.css';

interface Props { label: string; chart: ChartContext; onChange: (codes: ConnectSelection[]) => void }

export function CodedField({ label, chart, onChange }: Props) {
  const { pick } = useCodaConnect(chart);
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [codes, setCodes] = useState<ConnectSelection[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function code() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const result = await pick({ text, maxSelections: 3 });
      if (result) {
        setCodes(result.selections);
        onChange(result.selections);
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="coded-field">
      <label>
        {label}
        <div className="coded-field__row">
          <input value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Describe the diagnosis" />
          <button type="button" onClick={() => void code()} disabled={busy || !text.trim()}>
            {busy ? 'Coding…' : 'Code with CODA'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </label>
      {codes.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="coded-field__codes">
          {codes.map((c) => (
            <li key={c.system + '|' + c.code}><code>{c.code}</code> {c.display} <small>{c.systemKey} · {c.version}</small></li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `src/coda/CodedField.css`

Optional styling for the field. The CODA window brings its own styles; you need no CSS for it.

```css
.coded-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; font: 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; }
.coded-field__row { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 0.25rem; }
.coded-field__row input { flex: 1; padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid #cfd6de; border-radius: 8px; }
.coded-field__row button { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #0b6e69; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
.coded-field__row button:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }
.coded-field__codes { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; }
.coded-field__codes li { padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #e7f2f1; border: 1px solid #b9dad7; }
.coded-field__codes code { font-weight: 700; color: #0b6e69; }
.coded-field__codes small { color: #5f6b7a; }
```

## The webhook you receive

`connect.selection.completed`, signed with [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com/). The headers are `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature`.

```json
{ "id": "evt_…", "type": "connect.selection.completed", "timestamp": "…",
  "data": { "sessionId": "…", "appId": "…", "status": "completed", "purpose": "diagnosis",
            "patientRef": "pt_3f2b…", "encounterRef": "enc_9a1c…", "completedBy": "emr:…:usr_7c1d…",
            "selections": [{ "system": "http://id.who.int/icd/release/11/mms", "version": "2025-01", "code": "GB61.Z",
                             "display": "Chronic kidney disease, stage unspecified", "cwe": "GB61.Z^…^icd11-mms" }] } }
```

Delivery rules:

- Verify the signature on the **raw** body, and reject anything older than five minutes.
- Answer `2xx` quickly.
- De-duplicate on `webhook-id`: delivery is at least once, retried for up to 12 hours.

## Go-live checklist

- [ ] The app is registered with your production origins only. Each environment (test, production) has its own integration key.
- [ ] Integration keys live only in your server's secret store.
- [ ] The webhook endpoint is https, verifies signatures and de-duplicates on `webhook-id`.
- [ ] `patientRef`, `encounterRef` and `clinician.ref` are random tokens mapped in your system. Phrases carry no identifiers.
- [ ] You tried the flow in the CODA **EMR sandbox** and replayed events from the **Simulator**.
- [ ] A Business Associate Agreement is in place wherever PHI could reach CODA.
